name: devconnect
description: DevConnect - a social platform for developers with profiles, posts, projects, search, groups, notifications, and realtime chat. client/ and server/ are two fully independent apps (separate package.json + lockfile each) - this root file is only a local dev convenience, not a dependency owner. Either folder can be moved into its own git repo with no changes.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
